messages:
Alex (PM): Hey product — we need to lock the response metadata for the public API launch next sprint. Specifically: token usage fields, trace ids, minimal vs optional fields, and tool-calling/structured output compatibility. Customer asks: per-request token counts and stable trace ids for debugging. Thoughts?

Maria (API): Agree. Minimal required: request_id, trace_id, model, model_variant, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, status. Optional: billing_tokens, sample_rate, warnings. Keep names flat for SDKs.

Sam (ML Eng): Token accounting note: for streaming we only know final total after completion. If we surface partial counts we need a streaming event contract. Also quantized model variants can change tokenization; we must record tokenizer_version.

Jess (DevEx): +1 on flat names. Also add response_schema_version for safely evolving fields. SDKs can map old names -> new. Example fields we should require:
```json
{"response_schema_version":"v1","request_id":"uuid","trace_id":"hex128","prompt_tokens":42,"completion_tokens":15,"total_tokens":57}
```

Rahul (SRE): For distributed tracing please standardize trace_id as 16-byte hex (32 chars) and include span_id + parent_span_id when available. Also add sampling_flag or trace_flags. Example: trace_id=4b825... span_id=1a2b...

Maria (API): Concern: every additional field increases payload and some enterprise customers want minimal footprint. Proposal: required minimal set + opt-in detailed fields (billing_tokens, tokenizer_version, spans). We'll gate opt-in via header X-Response-Meta: full or minimal. Launch gating: spec doc, SDK + docs, canary, and eng sign-off on telemetry.

Alex (PM): OK — proposed final alignment (minimal required vs optional + launch checklist):
```text
Required: request_id, trace_id, model, model_variant, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, status, response_schema_version
Optional (opt-in header X-Response-Meta: full): billing_tokens, tokenizer_version, span_id, parent_span_id, trace_flags, warnings
Acceptance criteria: spec merged in repo, SDK changes + deprecations doc, canary with 5 customers, doc examples updated, e2e tracing verified, prod rollout plan
```

Jess (DevEx): I'll draft SDK PRs and migration guide. Also will add sample telemetry mapping for NewRelic/Jaeger.

deploy-bot: Canary initiated for metadata-v1 on 3 hosts :rocket: 

Alex (PM): Thanks all — next sync Thursday if PRs aren't ready. Ping me in-thread with blockers.
